title: SR-5.06 Support the company can actually deliver
request: Closes G47: Paid support has no address; Corporate promises 1-hour 24/7 response and embedded engineers a one-person company cannot give. Repository: mgillr/memev-ops. Depends on contracts: none.

criteria.statement: The SLA names who staffs it

stop_rules: If any criterion fails after the fix: STOP, report the measured result, the failing check and file:line. Do not start the next task.
